### **About**  
This module is primarily based on [Good Research Practice](https://www.vr.se/uppdrag/etik/god-forskningssed---ny-utgava.html) ('God forskningssed', VR, 2024) and the [European Code of Conduct for Research Integrity](https://allea.org/wp-content/uploads/2023/06/European-Code-of-Conduct-Revised-Edition-2023.pdf) (ALLEA, 2023). The information provided in this module is not exhaustive, but rather meant as an introduction to the topic. **Students are encouraged to further examine references to relevant laws and documents**. 

**Upon completion of this module, students will be able to:**   
- Demonstrate an understanding of ethical principles and legal frameworks governing research in Sweden  
- Execute every facet of an academic project according to Good Research Practice     
**Mode of study:** self-paced 
   
---   
  
### **Assignment**      
**Please work through chapters 1-7 and answer the reflection questions in the [Google form](https://forms.gle/yt1JWgwG3HuRU6KM7)**

Chapter overview:   
[1. Introduction to Good Research Practice](SS_GRP1.qmd)  
[2. GRP in acquiring funding](SS_GRP2.qmd)  
[3. GRP in experimental research](SS_GRP3.qmd)  
[4. GRP in (inter)national collaboration](SS_GRP4.qmd)  
[5. GRP in publishing and reviewing](SS_GRP5.qmd)  
[6. Scientific misconduct](SS_GRP6.qmd)  
[7. GRP and Open Science](SS_GRP7.qmd)  
[8. References](SS_GRP8.qmd)

### **Module creation** 
This educational module was created by compiling content from the sources referenced throughout. The material was then summarized with the assistance of ChatGPT (OpenAI, 2025), to distill key insights. Following this, the summary was reviewed and rewritten, and subsequently refined by three independent reviewers.
